content: Always lead with the lower-priced variant when the customer mentions a budget range, to avoid triggering price objections.
Use live demonstrations to overcome skepticism about compatibility or performance issues.
In S1, include a warm greeting and give the customer space to express their needs before diving into product details.
When quoting prices, immediately anchor to the customer's budget and highlight value equivalence (same battery, screen).

name: 现场演示破信任法
condition: When the customer expresses doubt about a feature (e.g., compatibility, performance).
example: Customer: 'Does it support Google Play?' Salesperson: 'Let me show you on the demo unit. Here's GBox, you can try it yourself.'

name: 价格锚定换算法
condition: When the customer objects to the price of a high-end model.
example: Customer: '55k is too much.' Salesperson: 'The 8GB+256GB model is only 48,999 ₽, within your budget, with the same battery and screen.'

name: 需求匹配降维法
condition: When the customer's needs are moderate and a lower-spec model suffices.
example: Customer: 'I need it for gaming and notes.' Salesperson: 'For your use, 8GB RAM is plenty. The 12GB model is overkill.'

objection: Price is too high (55,990 ₽ exceeds budget).
rebuttal_template: I understand. The good news is the 8GB+256GB model is only {price} ₽, which fits your budget of {budget} ₽. It has the same {key_features} as the higher model. Let me show you on the demo unit how smoothly it runs.

Let me show you right here on the demo unit. We have GBox installed, and you can sign in to your Google account and use Play Store, Gmail, and YouTube just like on any Android tablet. Would you like to try it?

This model has a 10,000mAh battery, which easily lasts a full campus day. Let me show you the battery settings and estimated usage time on the demo unit. For your usage of 2h gaming and 3h notes, you'll have plenty of charge left.
